Bank of America Commits ₹1,450 Crore to Hyderabad Office Lease

In one of Hyderabad’s major office leasing transactions of 2026, Bank of America, through its Indian arm BA Continuum India, has leased over 1 million sq. ft. of Grade-A office space at Mindspace Cyberabad, Madhapur.

Key Transaction Highlights:

▪️ Leased Area: 10.10 lakh sq. ft.
▪️ Location: Mindspace Cyberabad, Hyderabad
▪️ Lease Tenure: 12 years
▪️ Total Rental Commitment: Approximately ₹1,450 crore
▪️ Asset: Building No. 1, spanning 12 floors

The transaction reinforces Hyderabad’s position as a preferred destination for large-scale Global Capability Centre (GCC) operations.

What This Means for Commercial Real Estate

Large, long-term commitments from global financial institutions highlight three important trends:

✅ Sustained demand for institutional-grade office assets.

✅ Hyderabad’s established IT corridors continue to attract major corporate occupiers.

✅ Long-duration leases with multinational tenants reinforce the investment appeal of income-generating commercial real estate.

For commercial real estate investors, transactions of this scale demonstrate the importance of tenant quality, asset location and long-term rental visibility.

Hyderabad continues to strengthen its position as one of India’s leading corporate office markets.

Source: The Economic Times | 19 November 2026
